strings.name: Sheryl Sandberg
strings.summary: Sandberg studied economics and business at Harvard and worked at the Treasury and Google. Joining Facebook in 2008, she developed advertising and commercialization, leaving the COO role in 2022 and the board in 2024. Lean In and her book encouraged debate on women’s careers. Her tenure also faced privacy, political-interference and platform-accountability controversies.
